description: This file defines the FragmentArgumentsFragment class, which extends Android's Fragment class. It demonstrates fragment creation and configuration via Bundle arguments and layout inflation. The class creates child fragments within its onCreate method and inflates a layout in onCreateView.

classes.name: FragmentArgumentsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that initializes and embeds other fragments, demonstrating fragment transaction management and view inflation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes child fragments and adds them to the fragment container if this is the first creation (savedInstanceState is null).

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates and returns the fragment's associated layout view.
